run_passage_retrieval: run passage retrieval to search top-k documents for questions using a Contriever model and FAISS index
embed_queries_function: create embeddings for a list of query questions using a Contriever model and tokenizer in batches
index_encoded_data_function: index passage embeddings from pickle files into a FAISS index in configurable batch sizes
validate_function: validate retrieval results by calculating top-k document hit rates across multiple recall thresholds
add_passages_function: add retrieved passages and scores to query data by mapping document IDs to passage content
